items.title: Teradyne (TER) Opens Bengaluru Office To Support India Chip Manufacturing
items.summary: Teradyne (NasdaqGS:TER) has opened a new office in Bengaluru, India, to support domestic semiconductor and electronics manufacturing. The Bengaluru site is set up as a local hub for customer engagement, applications support, and technical training for Indian clients. The move aligns with Indian government efforts to expand local semiconductor fabrication and attract manufacturing investment into the country.
